panels.content:
What this chart shows:

This Dashboard shows the Real-Time and Historical Performance for the APIs

  • Shows Response Time trend for each APIs(in millisec) for the selected application over a specified time range.
  • Shows the request parameters like company ID, User Id, etc.

Why it matters:

  • Monitor latency patterns and identify anomalies.
  • Compare response times across different APIs.
  • Detect performance degradation over time.
  • Support root cause analysis and optimization efforts.
  • By focusing on response time metrics, this dashboard helps ensure application reliability and maintain SLA compliance.

Filters applied:

  • Scenario: The specific scenario that this execution result belong to
  • Env Name: The name of environment
  • Env Number: The environment identifier
  • Action: The specific action
  • Function: The function which should use to measure result
